extra.message: Insecure XML processing detected: Missing protection against external entity (XXE) attacks. The code creates a DocumentBuilderFactory without setting ACCESS_EXTERNAL_DTD and ACCESS_EXTERNAL_SCHEMA attributes to empty strings, which allows attackers to inject malicious XML entities. This vulnerability can lead to sensitive data exposure or denial of service. Fix by setting these attributes to empty strings as shown in the patch.
